# Forest-capacity guidance: bounded validation experiment

Prepared before new outcomes; **do not launch until the current comparison selects a base**.
This preparation provisionally uses baseline. If adaptive-search is selected, rebuild both apps
from that selected frozen prompt into a fresh directory, with this same single-sentence contrast,
unchanged requests and schedule. Recompute every application/package/plan hash. Do not compare
baseline with adaptive-plus-guidance: that would change two factors at once.

## Hypothesis and scope

Existing validation traces show oversized forests consuming scarce trials under model-byte caps.
The candidate adds exactly this sentence to the experiment section:

> When a model-byte cap limits feasibility, begin tree ensembles with few shallow trees and increase capacity only when measured size leaves room.

Eight fresh runs: Glass and Emotions × base and capacity guidance × two repeats. Alternate design
order on the second repeat. Requests, source checksums, expected specifications, seed42, budgets,
Luna model, one CPU, 2048MiB memory and 900-second platform timeout match the preceding frozen
comparison. Each request retains three trials and120 cumulative training seconds. No thresholds,
tools, dependencies, model defaults or verifier tolerances change. These are already inspected
validation datasets, not heldout generalization evidence. No other datasets are accessed.

## Preregistered measurements

For every scheduled attempt, retain terminal status, exact receipt agreement, audit outcome,
complete trial history and resource evidence. Report missing artifacts and infrastructure failures;
do not drop them or silently relaunch. Pair only matching case/repeat and frozen provenance.

1. **First-forest size compliance:** identify the earliest trial whose normalized family is
   extra_trees. Use its authority-measured complete model_bytes and the request's unchanged byte
   cap. At or below the cap is compliant; above it is noncompliant. Missing size is unmeasured,
   never compliant. An attempt with no forest is **no forest**, never a sizing success. Report
   compliant/noncompliant/unmeasured/no-forest counts over all attempts and, separately, measured
   first-forest compliance among attempts with a measured forest.
2. **Oversized trial count:** count every trial with a recorded model_bytes above the unchanged
   cap (with a separate forest-only count). Missing measurements remain explicitly unmeasured;
   zero known oversize trials is not proof of compliance when no model was measured. Also report
   total trials and forest trials, so avoiding forests cannot masquerade as better sizing.
3. **Best feasible CV objective:** among evaluated candidates meeting every original constraint,
   report highest macro F1 for Glass and highest micro F1 for Emotions. Preserve no-feasible as
   missing, not zero; show per-case paired deltas, never an average across task metrics. Use
   validation scores for design selection, never final-test objective values.
4. **Acceptance:** count independently verified successful receipts over all scheduled attempts.
   An honest no_feasible_model, incorrect interpretation, failed replay, missing receipt or
   infrastructure failure is not an accepted solution. Preserve its exact category separately.

Supporting metrics: fitted model bytes, required feature count, trial count, cumulative training
seconds, elapsed seconds and observed account spend. Account deltas may include other activity.

## Decision before results

Adopt additional guidance only if acceptance is preserved and paired feasible CV objectives do
not regress, with a repeat-consistent improvement on at least one dataset in CV objective or
measured search waste (fewer oversized trials / compliant first forests). Trace evidence must
show the size-aware choice, not merely fewer/no forests. Mixed one-off wins, unreadable evidence,
or equivalent outcomes favor retaining the simpler base prompt. With only two datasets and two
repeats, report uncertainty; no claim of universal superiority or statistical convergence.
If corrected base selection changes the comparison, freeze a fresh preparation before launch.

## Integrity and launch gate

provenance.json records source revision, exact request hashes, application content hashes, source
package hashes and package members. Preparation asserted the two trees differ only in prompt.md,
that its difference is exactly the sentence above, and that private evaluator data, tests,
requests and experiment metadata are absent from deployment packages. plan.json is compatible
with the existing ignored cloud_campaign.py layout. Its pending selection status is descriptive;
the controller does not enforce this approval gate. No launch was performed by preparation.

# Forest-overhead probe: refined validation hypothesis

**Do not launch before root reviews the completed first capacity batch.** No runs have been
launched for this preparation. Baseline is the selected comparison base; capacity-guidance is
the retained analyzer label for this new single-sentence contender.

## Why refine the hypothesis

The first capacity-guidance batch is still being collected. Observed guidance trials lowered
forest capacity but remained oversized: Glass50 trees at depth6/4 measured250493/145661 bytes
against100000; Emotions10 trees at depth3 measured115765/116085 against50000. These observations
motivated a more precise overhead-calibration instruction. They are not evidence that the new
instruction works. Preserve all first-batch attempts and its preregistration separately; do not
relabel, pool or replace those failures with refined-prompt outcomes.

The new contender adds exactly one sentence to the baseline experiment section:

> If you explore a forest under a model_bytes cap, first measure one depth-one tree to establish serialized overhead, then choose capacity from that evidence.

The prior 'few shallow trees' sentence is absent. No tool, runtime default, threshold, verifier,
feature eligibility or trial/training budget changes. Measuring a minimal tree consumes an
ordinary trial; it may reduce remaining search opportunities and harm quality, which the same
acceptance and quality criteria below will detect. No automatic forest-size calculation is added.

Eight fresh runs: Glass and Emotions × baseline/capacity-guidance × two repeats, alternating
variant order on repeat two. Requests/specifications/source checksums are identical to the first
capacity experiment, with three trials,120 cumulative training seconds, seed42, Luna, one CPU,
2048MiB, and900-second platform timeout. These remain inspected validation datasets, not heldout
agent generalization evidence. No heldout requests or outcomes are accessed.

## Preregistered measurements

For every scheduled attempt, retain terminal status, exact receipt agreement, audit outcome,
complete trial history and resource evidence. Report missing artifacts and infrastructure failures;
do not drop them or silently relaunch. Pair only matching case/repeat and frozen provenance.

1. **First-forest size compliance:** identify the earliest trial whose normalized family is
   extra_trees. Use its authority-measured complete model_bytes and the request's unchanged byte
   cap. At or below the cap is compliant; above it is noncompliant. Missing size is unmeasured,
   never compliant. An attempt with no forest is **no forest**, never a sizing success. Report
   compliant/noncompliant/unmeasured/no-forest counts over all attempts and, separately, measured
   first-forest compliance among attempts with a measured forest.
2. **Oversized trial count:** count every trial with a recorded model_bytes above the unchanged
   cap (with a separate forest-only count). Missing measurements remain explicitly unmeasured;
   zero known oversize trials is not proof of compliance when no model was measured. Also report
   total trials and forest trials, so avoiding forests cannot masquerade as better sizing.
3. **Best feasible CV objective:** among evaluated candidates meeting every original constraint,
   report highest macro F1 for Glass and highest micro F1 for Emotions. Preserve no-feasible as
   missing, not zero; show per-case paired deltas, never an average across task metrics. Use
   validation scores for design selection, never final-test objective values.
4. **Acceptance:** count independently verified successful receipts over all scheduled attempts.
   An honest no_feasible_model, incorrect interpretation, failed replay, missing receipt or
   infrastructure failure is not an accepted solution. Preserve its exact category separately.

Supporting metrics: fitted model bytes, required feature count, trial count, cumulative training
seconds, elapsed seconds and observed account spend. Account deltas may include other activity.

## Decision before results

Adopt additional guidance only if acceptance is preserved and paired feasible CV objectives do
not regress, with a repeat-consistent improvement on at least one dataset in CV objective or
measured search waste (fewer oversized trials / compliant first forests). Trace evidence must
show the size-aware choice, not merely fewer/no forests. Mixed one-off wins, unreadable evidence,
or equivalent outcomes favor retaining the simpler base prompt. With only two datasets and two
repeats, report uncertainty; no claim of universal superiority or statistical convergence.
If corrected base selection changes the comparison, freeze a fresh preparation before launch.

## Integrity and launch gate

hashes and members. Preparation verifies that only prompt.md differs and its exact difference
is the replacement sentence above; evaluator/private metadata are excluded from both source
packages. The baseline app matches the first capacity experiment byte for byte. The compatible
plan uses the existing cloud_campaign.py layout and capacity-guidance analyzer label. Its pending
status is descriptive: no controller enforcement or cloud submission is performed by preparation.

forest_trace.hypothesis: A shallow, leaf-regularized extra-trees ensemble should model nonlinear glass chemistry boundaries and improve macro-F1 while remaining under the 100000-byte model limit.
A depth-one ExtraTrees ensemble provides a compact nonlinear benchmark; measuring it at minimal depth tests whether shallow interactions improve macro-F1 without violating the model-size cap.
A very small shallow extra-trees ensemble tests whether nonlinear interactions improve micro-F1 while remaining within the strict complete-model byte budget.
Measure a depth-one single-tree ensemble first: it tests nonlinear splits while minimizing serialized overhead under the strict 50000-byte cap.
A shallow extra-trees ensemble can capture nonlinear interactions among chemical measurements while testing whether useful tree capacity remains within the 100000-byte cap.
A bounded extra-trees ensemble should model nonlinear class boundaries and interactions better than the linear model while remaining under the 100000-byte deployment limit.
Measure a minimal depth-one tree as a size-conscious nonlinear alternative; if feasible, it may capture a dominant acoustic split with lower or complementary error than the linear model.
A shallow 10-tree ensemble can model nonlinear interactions among spectral descriptors; limiting depth and tree count is intended to preserve feasibility under the 50000-byte complete-model cap.
